ideas.pitch: Real-time computer vision system that detects PPE non-compliance and hazardous zone breaches in manufacturing units using edge-optimized YOLO models.
ideas.title: VisionGuard Industrial Site Safety Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Computer Vision and Machine Learning themes directly, this solves a concrete industrial safety problem that academic judges at Chandigarh University can easily visualize and test with live webcam feeds.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first Android and web app using computer vision to diagnose crop leaf diseases and predict local yield outputs based on historical soil imagery.
ideas.title: CropLeaf Disease & Yield Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Machine Learning and Computer Vision into an impactful agricultural application, which scores high in Indian university hackathons due to its direct relevance to domestic economic challenges.

ideas.pitch: Automated retail shelf monitoring tool that uses object detection to identify misplaced stock, out-of-stock items, and planogram violations from store aisle photos.
ideas.title: RetailVision Shelf Compliance Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a tangible commercial automation problem with clear computer vision metrics like precision and inference speed, making it straightforward to impress judges during offline demos.

ideas.pitch: Machine learning model that processes real-time vehicle density estimations from intersection CCTV feeds to dynamically adjust traffic light timings and reduce congestion.
ideas.title: SmartTraffic Dynamic Signal Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates computer vision for object counting with a predictive regression model, showcasing end-to-end data pipeline execution within the 48-hour limit.

ideas.pitch: A specialized medical imaging analysis tool that highlights early-stage anomalies in X-ray and MRI scans, generating structured diagnostic report summaries.
ideas.title: MedScan AI Diagnostic Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages domain-specific image classification and NLP summary generation, showing deep technical execution across multiple AI themes.
